name: Kettle helm
description: A broad-brimmed iron hat for people who expect rain and arrows in equal measure.
notes: Fine medium helmet at the top of the mail weight range. Weight 2.5 kg (ADR-0003 reference weights). Catalogue tier fine (economy doc, helmets medium 70-120 x2.5). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
